_doc: Grand Junction Motor Speedway through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; ONE-CHAIN §4 row 10, Kevin 2026-11-01: 'get a complete track list and installed by morning'). The draft is the engine's own on the OSM raceway way 293789503 (source.type from_track over source/osm_fixes.json, smooth_window 0: gps -> elev -> project -> mesh), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso. Rehearsed offline 2026-11-01 up to elev (3DEP is unreachable from the cloud box): gps -> 1,321 m, 442 points from 53 OSM nodes, close_gap 127 m = the east straight's own last->first segment; with a zero-elevation stand-in the projection rotates the ring 399 points and vertex 0 lands 4.6 m from route.start_at on the east main straight, heading S into the SE hairpin, clockwise.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet (no pit lane, no kerbs where the real ones are, no CCW layout). Under V1 this track never went green: ledger 0018 / 0031, 'rough everywhere, mechanism not found' (engine v0.52.0: 1,032 m lap, severe 45 clustered at s 460 / 800 / 860, bumps 74.63/km against 75, kinks 129.9/km; profile despike and ribbon pleating both killed). Two things differ in this run, and they are what to read first: (1) the LINE: V1 drove a 5-fix moving average of a 53-node list, 5.7 m median / 14.4 m max off the OSM polygon, every corner cut by more than the 9.75 m road, the lap 22 % short (1,032 vs 1,321 m), so the deck sat partly on ground the graded pad is not on; this run drives the polygon (smooth_window 0). Check the gps print says 1.32 km / 442 points / close_gap 127 and the mesh step mints no bridge span (flat mesa: a span is the detector reading the wrong ground, ledger 0060). (2) the PREP: the chain's draft -> underlay -> prep, the first new thing to try (ONE-CHAIN §4). Then drive_test on the built kn5: severe steps (count, stations, which mesh group: ledger 0031 asks for exactly that attribution), bumps/km, kinks/km, replication — each against the V1 row above. If severe steps still cluster, hold the stations against the 11 corner apexes and against per-vertex width changes (0018's untested 'width step x crossfall'). No gate is loosened (L5, GATES-CHANGELOG): red means not installed, and the reports come back for diagnosis.
